title: Input schema for x-tweet-scraper
description: Targets + filters for scraping public tweets from X. At least one of fromUsers, tweetIds or searchTerms must be provided. All filters combine with AND semantics. Unspecified filters mean 'no constraint'.

fromUsers.title: From users
fromUsers.description: Handles (without @) whose tweets to scrape. Example: ["apify", "elonmusk"]

tweetIds.title: Tweet IDs
tweetIds.description: Specific tweet IDs to hydrate individually.

searchTerms.title: Search terms (bonus)
searchTerms.description: Free-text queries. Stretch surface: if unsupported, the run fails with a clear error instead of returning nothing.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Tweets must contain these hashtags (without #), applied as a post-filter.

since.title: Since
since.description: Inclusive window start (ISO-8601 date). Only tweets created at or after this are kept.

until.title: Until
until.description: Inclusive window end (ISO-8601 date). Only tweets created at or before this are kept.

language.title: Language
language.description: Filter by detected tweet language (ISO-639-1 code, e.g. "en").

onlyVerified.title: Only verified
onlyVerified.description: Only keep tweets from verified authors.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Count replies to other users as results.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Ordering for surfaces that support it.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Requested cap. Subject to the free-tier limit (free users always get at most 10).

proxyConfiguration.title: Apify proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Standard Apify proxy settings (groups, country, session).
